title: feat(spec): responsiveStyles on the UI page-component envelope (ADR-0065)
body:
Implements the spec half of **ADR-0065** (SDUI styling model).

## What

- `responsive.zod.ts` — `StyleMapSchema` (CSS property→value map, camelCase) + `ResponsiveStylesSchema` (`large`/`medium`/`small`/`xsmall` maps, desktop-first).
- `page.zod.ts` — `PageComponentSchema` gains an optional `responsiveStyles` field.

This is the **preferred, build-independent, collision-free** styling channel for metadata-authored pages, compiled to id-scoped CSS at render by objectui's `SchemaRenderer` (objectstack-ai/objectui#1912). Explicitly **distinct** from the existing `responsive` (`ResponsiveConfigSchema`), which configures *layout* (grid columns / visibility / order) on the Tailwind `xs..2xl` axis — `responsiveStyles` styles a node's own box.

## Verification

- `pnpm build` (tsc DTS) clean; `api-surface.json` refreshed (adds `ResponsiveStyles`/`ResponsiveStylesSchema`/`StyleMap`/`StyleMapSchema`).
- Spec suite **6612 passed / 245 files** — additive optional field, no regression.

Consumed by objectui (renderer, merged) and cloud (migrates built-in pages off raw className).
